title: IS216 - Group Project - Proposal
snapshotNote: Placeholder page. Text copied from the Drive proposal Word on 24 Sep 2026. Not a live Google Doc.
overview: With numerous online shopping platforms offering the same products at varying prices, consumers constantly face a purchase dilemma. They constantly have to switch between multiple online shopping platforms to compare prices and reviews before making a purchase. This takes time and effort, and they may still be unsure if they found the best deal or if the purchase is actually worth it.

FastDeal is a website for that. A user types a product name, or uploads a photo of the product. The app calls SerpApi Google Shopping, shows listings side by side, marks the cheapest, and asks Gemini for a short worth-it note. It also stores searches in FastDeal so a user can see what other FastDeal users searched, and which names often appear together.
objectives: Put prices, store names, ratings, and review counts for one product on one page.
Let the user start from a typed name or from a photo.
Use Gemini AI to generate a Worth It? verdict based on price and reviews, and give a short explanation behind each verdict, making trade-offs clear to users
Let a logged-in user save a product and open it again.
Show what other FastDeal users searched, and which product names were searched together.

functionality.name: Product Search
functionality.text: User types a product name. The app fetches live listings from Google Shopping via SerpApi.

functionality.name: Price Comparison and Best Price
functionality.text: The app displays price, store name, seller rating, and review count in a single table, highlighting the cheapest row with badges.

functionality.name: AI Worth It? Verdict
functionality.text: AI analyses all listings and returns a verdict (Worth It / Maybe / Not Worth It) with a short explanation.

functionality.name: Save / Wishlist
functionality.text: Logged-in users can save products to revisit later.

functionality.name: User Authentication
functionality.text: Sign up and log in with email or password via Firebase.

functionality.name: Image search
functionality.text: User uploads a product photo on the website. The app identifies the product and opens the same compare table as a typed search. This is a file input in Chrome, not a phone camera app.

functionality.name: Other users' searches
functionality.text: The app stores anonymised queries and product names. One screen lists what people searched for and how often. A product page can list names that were searched with it. Demo rows are seeded, so the screens are not empty.

technology.name: SerpApi Google Lens
technology.text: Photo to product name for image search.

technology.name: Render
technology.text: For Deployment. Vue front-end and Express back-end on one web service

dataStores: MongoDB Atlas stores user records, wishlist items, and search logs (query text, product name, count). Firebase Authentication stores credentials. Search logs are anonymised on the public screens.

apis.name: SerpApi Google Shopping API
apis.text: Fetches real-time product listings (price, store, seller, rating) across multiple online retailers when a user searches for a product.

apis.name: Google Gemini API
apis.text: Receives the aggregated product listings and generates an AI Worth It? verdict with a plain-English explanation of the best deal.

apis.name: SerpApi Google Lens
apis.text: Turns an uploaded product photo into a product name, then performs the same Shopping search.

apis.name: Firebase Authentication API
apis.text: Handles user sign-up, login, and session management via email/password.
